description: Create an owned old-site/new-site plan. Next call import_inventory for the old and new URL lists; planning does not crawl or run the model.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."

new_site.description: Origin of available destination pages, e.g. https://new.example; no page path, query, fragment or credentials.

old_site.description: Origin of existing source pages, e.g. https://old.example; no page path, query, fragment or credentials.

site_aliases.description: Additional explicitly allowed origins per side. Declare www or staging origins here before importing; aliases are not inferred.
